biomass and a source-sink imbalance, making oats more vulnerable to
environmental stress. Last season’s trials support this, showing excessive
nitrogen reduced harvest index and grain weight, ultimately lowering
yields—likely due to increased biomass and greater susceptibility to terminal
drought.
